parts:
Hi all, 

I seem to be having a problem with trying to get the predicted values for detection from the average of my best/selected models, which seems to be producing the error message (included below). I think is due to the fact that the observation covariate 'transect distance' (classed as a list of all repeat distances R1-R11) is included for detection, as getting the data for occupancy has been fine, but I am not sure how I can solve this issue. 
I'm still fairly new to occupancy so any help would be greatly appreciated, thank you in advance! 

I have included a screenshot of my unmarked frame below and my best models include: 
at6 <- occu(formula= ~dist~NDVI, data=umf) 
dt6 <- occu(formula= ~traps_km~NDVI, data=umf) 



Many thanks,
